ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the circuit diagram, point A is on the left side, and point B is on the right side. R1, R2, and R3 are located in sequence on the upper horizontal branch; the left end of capacitor C is connected to the connection point between R1 and R2, and the right end is connected to the right end of R3, that is, point B. Below, there is a power supply and switch S connected in series between A and B. The ammeter branch is connected directly from point A to the connection point between R2 and R3, and the problem states that the internal resistance of the ammeter can be ignored, so point A and the connection point between R2 and R3 can be regarded as the same equipotential node. Reasoning: After switch S is closed and stability is reached, the capacitor is equivalent to an open circuit. Since the ammeter shorts point A and the connection point between R2 and R3, R1 and R2 actually only connect the intermediate node of R1 and R2 to the same equipotential node A, so in the steady state there is no current in R1 and R2, and the potential of the connection point between R1 and R2 is also equal to the potential of point A. Therefore the voltage across the capacitor is equal to the terminal voltage U_AB of the power supply. In the external circuit, the effective load is only R3=4Ω, in series with the internal resistance r=1Ω of the power supply, so the current I=E/(R3+r)=4/(4+1)=0.8A, and the terminal voltage U=IR3=0.8×4=3.2V. The charge on the capacitor Q=CU=20×10^-6×3.2=6.4×10^-5C. After switch S is opened, the power-supply branch is disconnected, and the capacitor discharges through the external resistor network. From the short-circuit relationship in the figure, the discharge path is equivalent to R3 in series with the parallel part of R1 and R2, that is, R3 in series with (R1||R2). The total charge originally stored in the capacitor is 6.4×10^-5C; when it passes through the parallel branch, because R1=R2, the amounts of charge flowing through R1 and R2 are equal, so the amount of charge through R2 is half of the total charge: Q_R2=0.5×6.4×10^-5=3.2×10^-5C.

method.method_draft: First read the circuit topology from the image: the ammeter branch connects point A directly to the junction of R2 and R3, so with negligible ammeter resistance those two points are the same node. The capacitor is connected between the junction of R1 and R2 and point B. From the text, use E = 4 V, internal resistance r = 1 Ω, R1 = R2 = R3 = 4 Ω, and C = 20 μF. With switch S closed and after a long time, treat the capacitor as an open circuit. Because the junction of R1 and R2 is connected only through R1 and R2 to the same equipotential node A, no steady current flows in R1 or R2, so that junction is also at potential A. Thus the capacitor voltage equals the terminal voltage between A and B. The only effective external load is R3 = 4 Ω in series with internal resistance 1 Ω, giving current 4/(4+1) = 0.8 A and terminal voltage 0.8 × 4 = 3.2 V. Then Q = CV = 20 μF × 3.2 V = 6.4×10^-5 C. After opening S, the source branch is disconnected and the charged capacitor discharges through R3 in series with the parallel pair R1 || R2. Since R1 and R2 are equal, the discharge charge through the parallel part splits equally, so the charge through R2 is half the initial capacitor charge: 3.2×10^-5 C.

图像描述：电路图中，A 点在左侧，B 点在右侧。R1、R2、R3 依次位于上方水平支路上；电容 C 的左端接在 R1 与 R2 的连接点，右端接在 R3 右端也就是 B 点。下方有电源和开关 S 串接在 A、B 之间。安培表支路从 A 点直接连到 R2 与 R3 的连接点，且题目说明安培表内阻可忽略，因此 A 点与 R2、R3 的连接点可视为同一等势节点。

推理：开关 S 闭合并达到稳定后，电容相当于断路。由于安培表把 A 点与 R2、R3 的连接点短接，R1 和 R2 实际上只把 R1、R2 的中间节点连接到同一个等势节点 A，因此稳态下 R1、R2 中无电流，R1 与 R2 的连接点电势也等于 A 点电势。所以电容两端电压等于电源的路端电压 U_AB。外电路中有效负载只有 R3=4Ω，与电源内阻 r=1Ω 串联，因此电流 I=E/(R3+r)=4/(4+1)=0.8A，路端电压 U=IR3=0.8×4=3.2V。电容电荷量 Q=CU=20×10^-6×3.2=6.4×10^-5C。

开关 S 断开后，电源支路断开，电容通过外部电阻网络放电。由图中短接关系，放电路径等效为 R3 与 R1、R2 的并联部分串联，即 R3 串联 (R1||R2)。电容原先储存的总电荷为 6.4×10^-5C，其中经过并联支路时，由于 R1=R2，流过 R1 和 R2 的电荷量相等，所以通过 R2 的电荷量为总电荷的一半：Q_R2=0.5×6.4×10^-5=3.2×10^-5C。

method.method_draft: Use a node-potential/charge-conservation approach. From the image, label the R1-R2 junction as X, the R2-R3 junction as Y, and note that the ideal ammeter connects Y to A, so VA = VY. The capacitor is between X and B. From the text, take E = 4 V, r = 1 Ω, R1 = R2 = R3 = 4 Ω, C = 20 μF. For the closed-switch final state, impose zero capacitor current. Apply KCL at node X: since X connects only to A through R1 and to A through R2, (VX − VA)/R1 + (VX − VA)/R2 = 0, so VX = VA. Therefore the capacitor voltage is VA − VB. The only branch drawing source current between A and B is R3, so VA − VB is the terminal voltage across R3: VA − VB = E·R3/(r + R3) = 4·4/(1+4) = 3.2 V. Hence the stored charge is 20 μF × 3.2 V = 6.4×10^-5 C. When S is opened, no source remains in the discharge loop. The initial capacitor charge must pass from one plate to the other through the resistor network between X and B. At node A/Y the charge entering or leaving the parallel pair R1 and R2 splits according to conductance; because R1 = R2, exactly half of the capacitor’s total discharged charge passes through R2. Thus q_R2 = 0.5 × 6.4×10^-5 C = 3.2×10^-5 C.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路图中，A 到 B 的上方主支路依次有 R1、R2、R3 三个电阻。R1 与 R2 的连接点记为 X，R2 与 R3 的连接点记为 Y。电容 C 接在 X 与 B 之间。理想电流表接在 A 与 Y 之间，因此 A 与 Y 等电势。下方电源和开关 S 串联后接在 A、B 两端。

推理：已知电源电动势 E = 4 V，内阻 r = 1 Ω，R1 = R2 = R3 = 4 Ω，C = 20 μF。开关闭合后达到稳定状态时，电容支路无直流电流。节点 X 只通过 R1、R2 与等势节点 A/Y 相连，因此由节点电流方程 (VX - VA)/R1 + (VX - VA)/R2 = 0，得 VX = VA。所以电容两端电压等于 VA - VB。此时真正从电源取电流的外电路只有 R3，故 A、B 间端电压为 UAB = E·R3/(r + R3) = 4×4/(1+4) = 3.2 V。因此电容所带电荷 Q = CU = 20×10^-6×3.2 = 6.4×10^-5 C。

断开开关 S 后，电源不再参与放电回路，电容通过 X 到 B 之间的电阻网络放电。X 到 A/Y 之间有 R1、R2 两个相等电阻并联，流过这部分的总放电电荷在 R1 和 R2 中按电导分配；因 R1 = R2，所以通过 R2 的电荷为总电荷的一半，即 q_R2 = 0.5×6.4×10^-5 = 3.2×10^-5 C。

图像描述：电路图中，A 到 B 的上方主支路依次有 R1、R2、R3 三个电阻。R1 与 R2 的连接点记为 X，R2 与 R3 的连接点记为 Y。电容 C 接在 X 与 B 之间。理想电流表接在 A 与 Y 之间，因此 A 与 Y 等电势。下方电源和开关 S 串联后接在 A、B 两端。

推理：已知电源电动势 E = 4 V，内阻 r = 1 Ω，R1 = R2 = R3 = 4 Ω，C = 20 μF。开关闭合后达到稳定状态时，电容支路无直流电流。节点 X 只通过 R1、R2 与等势节点 A/Y 相连，因此由节点电流方程 (VX - VA)/R1 + (VX - VA)/R2 = 0，得 VX = VA。所以电容两端电压等于 VA - VB。此时真正从电源取电流的外电路只有 R3，故 A、B 间端电压为 UAB = E·R3/(r + R3) = 4×4/(1+4) = 3.2 V。因此电容所带电荷 Q = CU = 20×10^-6×3.2 = 6.4×10^-5 C。

断开开关 S 后，电源不再参与放电回路，电容通过 X 到 B 之间的电阻网络放电。X 到 A/Y 之间有 R1、R2 两个相等电阻并联，流过这部分的总放电电荷在 R1 和 R2 中按电导分配；因 R1 = R2，所以通过 R2 的电荷为总电荷的一半，即 q_R2 = 0.5×6.4×10^-5 = 3.2×10^-5 C。

raw_record.original_question:
As shown in the circuit, a DC power source with an electromotive force of 4V and an internal resistance of $1\Omega$ is connected between points $A$ and $B$. The resistances of the three resistors are all $4\Omega$, the capacitance of the capacitor is $20\upmu\mathrm{F}$, and the internal resistance of the ammeter is negligible.

1. After closing switch S, the amount of charge stored on the capacitor.
2. After opening switch S, the amount of charge passing through $R_{2}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the circuit diagram, point A is on the left side, and point B is on the right side. R1, R2, and R3 are located in sequence on the upper horizontal branch; the left end of capacitor C is connected to the connection point between R1 and R2, and the right end is connected to the right end of R3, that is, point B. Below, there is a power supply and switch S connected in series between A and B. The ammeter branch is connected directly from point A to the connection point between R2 and R3, and the problem states that the internal resistance of the ammeter can be ignored, so point A and the connection point between R2 and R3 can be regarded as the same equipotential node.

Reasoning: After switch S is closed and stability is reached, the capacitor is equivalent to an open circuit. Since the ammeter shorts point A and the connection point between R2 and R3, R1 and R2 actually only connect the intermediate node of R1 and R2 to the same equipotential node A, so in the steady state there is no current in R1 and R2, and the potential of the connection point between R1 and R2 is also equal to the potential of point A. Therefore the voltage across the capacitor is equal to the terminal voltage U_AB of the power supply. In the external circuit, the effective load is only R3=4Ω, in series with the internal resistance r=1Ω of the power supply, so the current I=E/(R3+r)=4/(4+1)=0.8A, and the terminal voltage U=IR3=0.8×4=3.2V. The charge on the capacitor Q=CU=20×10^-6×3.2=6.4×10^-5C.

After switch S is opened, the power-supply branch is disconnected, and the capacitor discharges through the external resistor network. From the short-circuit relationship in the figure, the discharge path is equivalent to R3 in series with the parallel part of R1 and R2, that is, R3 in series with (R1||R2). The total charge originally stored in the capacitor is 6.4×10^-5C; when it passes through the parallel branch, because R1=R2, the amounts of charge flowing through R1 and R2 are equal, so the amount of charge through R2 is half of the total charge: Q_R2=0.5×6.4×10^-5=3.2×10^-5C.
